findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` on light themes
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss` line 291, `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The 30% and 70% lightness values appear to be swapped compared to every other `30%` conversion in this PR (which map to `30%` for light themes and `70%` for dark themes), making the author link in embedded posts much lighter on light themes and much darker on dark themes than before.

findings.title: Swapped lightness percentages for `.custom-message-length` in mobile modal
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss` line 102, `.custom-message-length` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. Unlike `desktop/modal.scss` line 94 (which uses `70%` for `$primary` and `30%` for `$secondary`), the lightness arguments here are inverted, causing the custom message length counter on mobile to become much darker on light themes and much lighter on dark themes.

findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.group-member-info .name` on desktop
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss` line 522, `.user-stream .group-member-info .name` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. This alters the existing light-theme color of `.name` so it is no longer darker/more prominent than `.title` right below it.

findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.group-member-info .name` on mobile
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss` line 497, `.user-stream .group-member-info .name` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, losing the visual distinction between `.name` and `.title` on light themes.

findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.topic-map h3` on mobile
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss` line 182, `.topic-map h3` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))` (which is what `desktop/topic-post.scss` line 321 and `mobile/topic-post.scss` line 247 use). This makes `.topic-map h3` lighter on light themes and removes the contrast difference between `h3` and `h4`.
